method: Temporary classpath overlay; repository production sources and Maven outputs unchanged. Existing corpus assertion method invoked directly; not a JUnit/Maven full suite.
invocation_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd __LOCAL_HOME__/Projects/JavaProjects/docweave
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/docweave-tesseract-runtime/usr/lib
classpath="$(cat /tmp/docweave-validation-classpath.txt)"
for module in docweave-core docweave-pdf docweave-layout-onnx docweave-ocr-tesseract; do classpath="$PWD/$module/target/classes:$classpath"; done
for version in 21 25; do
 if [ "$version" = 21 ]; then jdk=/tmp/docweave-jdk21; else jdk=__LOCAL_HOME__/.sdkman/candidates/java/25.0.4-amzn; fi
 directory="/tmp/docweave-detector-resolution/java$version"
 mkdir -p "$directory/launcher" "$directory/overlay"
 "$jdk/bin/javac" --release 21 -cp "$classpath" -d "$directory/launcher" /tmp/docweave-detector-resolution/RunScanExperiment.java
 "$jdk/bin/javac" --release 21 -cp "$classpath" -d "$directory/overlay" /tmp/docweave-detector-resolution/ManagedTatrSession.java /tmp/docweave-detector-resolution/ExperimentalDetectorTransform.java
 for side in 800 1200; do
  runpath="$directory/launcher:$classpath"
  if [ "$side" = 1200 ]; then runpath="$directory/overlay:$runpath"; fi
  stem="/tmp/docweave-detector-resolution/max${side}-java${version}"
  "$jdk/bin/java" -Djava.awt.headless=true -cp "$runpath" -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.cache=/tmp/docweave-ctdar -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.report="$stem.json" -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.coverage=ALL_PUBLISHED_SAMPLES -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.dpi=150 -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.tableDetection=PROVIDER_LAYOUT -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.layoutModel=/tmp/docweave-table-models/structure-all/structure.onnx -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.layoutSha256=ff1d19a18cb5f041c1692ff681f891a5180f9430d68a71d2cf7a0a2e8e55b990 -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.detectionModel=/tmp/docweave-table-models/detection/detection.onnx -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.detectionSha256=0f625baa8849eff26e265ce08a2f6b1479e73f52edd5adc09799c7e7fcc689b9 -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.orientation=true -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.layoutMergeConflicts=KEEP_HIGHER_SCORE -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.preferRuled=true -Ddocweave.tesseract.executable=/tmp/docweave-tesseract-runtime/usr/bin/tesseract -Ddocweave.tesseract.tessdata=/tmp/docweave-tesseract-runtime/usr/share/tessdata dev.docweave.validation.RunScanExperiment > "$stem.log" 2>&1
  echo "Completed $stem"
 done
done
limitations: Development corpus with no OCR text transcription oracle.
Higher resolution is an explicit experiment, not a claim to upstream published preprocessing equivalence.
No production settings promoted; twenty-image scientific corpus not replayed because this experiment offers no additional exact scan topology match.
Candidate count and ordinary OCR line counts are diagnostics, not text quality or semantic table accuracy.
